description: This file contains unit tests for POSIX socket accept behavior, including invalid socket, no connection, not bound, and not listening scenarios.

methods.name: RainyDayInvalidSocket
methods.description: Tests accept() with an invalid socket descriptor (-1).

methods.name: RainyDayNoConnection
methods.description: Sets up a listening socket and verifies accept() returns error when no connection is made.

methods.name: RainyDayNotBound
methods.description: Tests accept() on a socket that is not bound or listening.

methods.name: RainyDayNotListening
methods.description: Sets up a socket, binds it but does not listen, then tests accept() returns error.
